worldcombat.skill.icepunch.summary: A frost-covered fist strikes the first target along the aim direction and leaves a chill that slows it. If the target is already chilled, or standing in water, it first tries to freeze it solid (longer while wet), and only pulls the frost away when the freeze truly lands. A target immune to freezing keeps its existing chill, and the punch damage still lands.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.use.0: Coat a target in a slowing chill at close range
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.use.1: Finish with a freeze against an already chilled or soaked target
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.use.2: Stop a key target in its tracks
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.description.0: The punch deals %1$s contact and punch damage over a fixed reach of about %2$s blocks; it never stretches for a target that runs, and walls or other bodies block it.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.description.1: A hit coats the target in a chill for %1$s, reducing its movement speed by 55%; that chill is also the prerequisite for freezing it.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.description.2: If the target is already chilled or standing in water, it first tries to freeze it for %1$s (x1.5 while wet); the chill is removed only if the freeze truly lands. A target that cannot be frozen (such as an Ice type) keeps its existing chill, and the visuals show only brittle shards and resistance. While frozen it cannot start new moves or ordinary attacks and cannot move, and Fire damage thaws it.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.deepfreeze.on: Deep freeze: a longer freeze and a longer chill, but a lighter punch and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.deepfreeze.of: Flash freeze: a heavier punch and a faster cycle, but shorter control.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.growth.0: From level %1$s the power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.growth.1: From level %1$s the power rises to %2$s and the freeze duration to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.preference.de: On: freeze duration x1.4, chill duration x1.2, but punch power x0.9 and cooldown +5 ticks, for locking down a key target. Off (flash freeze): a heavier punch and a faster cycle, but shorter control.
worldcombat.skill.icepunch.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. The ice punch reach is short, so a large value often still cannot connect.
On: targets already chilled or standing in water rank first, since this punch freezes them; off: order by ordinary melee only.
